result.summary: The PR changes the bounds check in src/bounds.ts from `index < length` to `index <= length`, causing index == length to be accepted as in-bounds. This violates the documented contract that valid integer indices for a collection of length N are 0 through N-1, and it breaks the empty-collection case (length 0 has no valid index).
